method: Library-level reproduction of the upstream IDMapper class test (in-memory literals transcribed; the consensusXML files the class test compares with TEST_FILE_SIMILAR are loaded and compared identification by identification: RT, m/z, hit sequences and charges, and the map_index, spectrum_index and spectrum_reference meta values) and of the six TOPP_IDMapper tests of test-data 0cb15f2 (topp/CMakeLists.txt: the add_test invocations are reproduced as IDMapper parameters plus the TOPP tool's own option defaults from topp 174b576 src/IDMapper.cpp - mz_reference defaults to 'peptide', feature:use_centroid_mz to 'true' - and the retained outputs are compared the same way; for consensus maps the tool's sortPeptideIdentificationsByMapIndex is applied). Run identifiers, dates and data-processing records are not compared: the C++ writer names runs and stamps dates itself, and the FuzzyDiff whitelist exempts them. Three reader defects (idXML/featureXML/consensusXML refuse the unset DateTime text, the flanking residue '*' and a repeated SearchParameters UserParam, all of which C++ reads) are worked around in memory by tests/id_mapper.rs::fixture_text; none of the rewritten fields reaches the mapping. The isobaric (TMT) branch, which no retained output exercises, was run through an executed C++ oracle (see external_reference_artifacts).
evidence_tier: Tier 1 (retained C++ outputs: the class-test consensusXML expectations and the TOPP_IDMapper_1..6 outputs) for annotate_consensus_matches_class_test_outputs, annotate_consensus_unidentified_precursors_match_class_test_outputs and topp_idmapper_1..6; tier 1 (executed C++ oracle ../oracle/I4-idmapper-tmt, Release build on ibminode06) for isobaric_mapping_matches_cpp_oracle; tier 3 (transcribed class-test literals) for the parameter, absolute_mz_tolerance, is_match, annotate_spectra, annotate_features and charge-check tests; tier 4 (independently derived from the source text) for annotate_spectra_from_features_fills_coordinates, annotate_spectra_edge_cases, map_precursors_partitions_spectra, the atomicity and limit tests and the unit tests in src/analysis/id/id_mapper.rs.
upstream_test_definition: test-data 0cb15f2 topp/CMakeLists.txt:2963-2992, the '# IDMapper tests' block (TOPP_IDMapper_1 .. TOPP_IDMapper_6_out1)
